create_MapperIterDataPipe_map: create a MapperIterDataPipe to apply a function to each item from a source DataPipe
create_CollatorIterDataPipe_collate: create a CollatorIterDataPipe to collate samples from a DataPipe into tensors using a custom collate function
build_MapperIterDataPipe_input_col: build a MapperIterDataPipe that applies a function to specific input columns from list or tuple data
build_CollatorIterDataPipe_conversion: build a CollatorIterDataPipe with a conversion dictionary mapping column names to callable collation functions
test_MapperIterDataPipe_len: test MapperIterDataPipe length delegation from a sized source DataPipe
